newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Endesa studies aluminum smelter.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Endesa studies aluminum smelter.

text.p: Chilean power utility Empresa Nacional de Electricidad (Endesa) is studying building an aluminum smelter and has had talks with Canadian mining company Noranda, said an Endesa official.
"We are studying an aluminum project with international partners," Mario Rodriguez, Endesa's mining manager, told reporters.
"We have spoken to Noranda but everything is very preliminary," he added.
Noranda announced last year that it was not proceeding with plans for the $1.6 billion Alumysa aluminum and hydroelectric project in far southern Chile.
But there have been media reports that the company has recently decided to reactivate to the project.
